meta.question: How did Singapore transform from a trading port to a global financial hub?

sources.title: Singapore - Wikipedia
sources.evidence: Singapore is a sovereign island city-state in maritime Southeast Asia. It lies about one degree of latitude north of the equator.

sources.title: History of Singapore - Wikipedia
sources.evidence: Modern Singapore was founded in 1819 by Sir Stamford Raffles as a trading post of the British Empire. The Port of Singapore became one of the world's busiest.

sources.title: Economy of Singapore - Wikipedia
sources.evidence: Singapore has a highly developed free-market economy. It is ranked as the most open in the world, least corrupt, and most pro-business.
